title: Japanese Lamb Kebabs with Sicilian Cassata
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors with the rich taste of lamb, served with a sweet Sicilian cassata. This dish is perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat.
Grill lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast ramen noodles in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
To assemble the dish, place grilled lamb on a plate, top with toasted ramen noodles, and serve with sliced Sicilian cassata.
Garnish with additional sesame oil and serve immediately.
